key_design_notes: Trust boundary: packages/reports/import/open.ts calls the T24 importReport gate for ALL parsing, bounds, duplicate-key/prototype-key audits, closed-schema+semantic validation, digest and asset-signature verification, and PNG sanitization — nothing is re-parsed or re-validated downstream. The package only derives source standing, verbatim scope/omissions disclosure, reader availability, comparison readiness and inert view models.

Failure classification maps gate ContractError codes to four UI kinds: not_a_report (container/markup/kind/parse violations), unsupported_version (declared schema_version extracted only on SCHEMA failure), too_large (SIZE), invalid (schema/semantic/hash/asset). Version detail is re-parsed via loadsStrict — never a second JSON.parse.

Replay semantics (I09): SourceState = embedded (verified source_pdf asset) | required (replay requires_original) | not_applicable (diagnostic). verifySourceCandidate binds a locally chosen PDF only on exact byte_length+sha256 equality — a hash is never sufficient and a mismatch is never attached.

Source-read generation binding (I07, F1 fix): offerSource refuses while offer/offerCompareSide is busy, captures the opened report and generation before the byte read, and after the await drops the result if either changed — a replace or clear always wins; the stale read emits nothing, owns nothing and attaches nothing.

Reader availability (I10): the app supplies the installed-reader allowlist (pdf.js adapter identities); recorded Reader.ids match by exact equality; misses are named unavailable — a report can never select, install or substitute an executable/profile.

Comparison requires two explicit local selections through real file inputs; prepareComparison yields same_report / incomparable (different document bytes) / ready — report ids or URLs are never input.

Lifecycle (I07): the controller drives the same RunCoordinator file lifecycle as T08 (idle -> validating_file -> loading_metadata -> selecting). A new offer while live emits clear intent then requestClear('replace') — generation increments BEFORE teardown; the imported report and attached source bytes are file-scoped owned resources released under the new generation.

UI honesty: every report-controlled string renders as a React text node inside <bdi> (no innerHTML/autolinking); images come only from the gate's sanitized PNG re-encode as data: URLs; scope.included/omissions and replay/copy strings are verbatim from copy.json; the replace path stands behind an explicit confirm dialog.

Web feature decoupling mirrors state/store.ts and features/export: ImportEngine/ImportHost are structural ports because apps/web tsconfig cannot resolve cross-package .ts specifiers; the concrete binding lives in mount.tsx (__t22).
limitations: apps/web tsc baseline fails on missing React typings (1008 errors: TS7016 react/react-jsx-runtime + TS7026 JSX.IntrinsicElements + TS7006/TS7031 implicit-any on the untyped React surface) — pre-existing across the app; features/import contributes 290 diagnostics that are all the same baseline, zero non-baseline. @types/react not installed; lockfile frozen. Reviewer reproduced 1008/290 exactly.
The preview mount (preview.html + __t22) is the only composition wiring — App.tsx routing belongs to a later app-composition task, same constraint as T16's feature.

Replay readiness is gated and surfaced (source present + zero missing readers) but no replay execution runs — the contract requires the explicit local-source gate and environment disclosure, not a new run path.

F24/F25/F26 are specified-not-generated in this branch; their import-facing semantics are exercised through constructed variants on the real delivered examples (reader substitution, hostile strings, annotations opt-in) — documented in the spec header.
